high_level_description: This image depicts a dimly lit yoga class. The setting appears to be an indoor space with a high ceiling, featuring a grid of square tiles. The lighting is low, creating a warm, orange hue that emanates from the windows on one side of the room. This soft light contrasts with the darker areas of the room. In the foreground, several individuals are seated on yoga mats, engaged in yoga practices. Their postures suggest they are either in a seated position or transitioning between poses. One person is standing near the back of the room, possibly leading the class or observing the participants.
